criteria.reasoning: The memo says "Do not move $3,000 of the $15,000 grant to the gala invoice" and "Do not accept a second, smaller grant just for the table." The reply tells Peggy "I cannot apply $3,000 of the Kestrel grant to your Starlight Gala table, and I cannot accept a separate Kestrel grant for the table either."

The memo says to "Leave INV-G26-0112 unpaid until the Halvorsens pay personally." The reply says the table "remains payable only with personal funds (personal check, card or other personal funds — never a DAF)" and asks "Please send personal payment by October 2."
The memo computes "fair market value 8 × $185 = $1,480". The reply cites "$185 per guest ($1,480 for 8)".

The memo gives "deductible amount $3,000 minus $1,480 = $1,520". It says the acknowledgment "includes that disclosure" that the deductible amount is limited to the excess of the payment over the value of goods or services, and that it goes to the Halvorsens. The reply also promises a quid pro quo acknowledgment stating "the deductible excess of $1,520".
Section 5A directs the formal acknowledgment to Kestrel Charitable Trust, stating "the grant amount ($15,000.00), the date received ... and that no goods or services were provided in exchange."

The memo says "Do not mention the Halvorsens' $40,000 statement of intent ... or its balance in the Kestrel letter." The Kestrel acknowledgment it describes covers only the amount, date, the no-goods-or-services statement and the fund-name recognition, with no reference to the gala.

The reply says "I cannot send you a tax receipt for the $15,000". It adds that the thank-you letter "cannot describe the grant as tax-deductible to you, call itself a tax receipt, or address you as the donor." Nothing implies the grant is deductible to the Halvorsens.

The reply explains that "The grant is legally a gift from Kestrel Charitable Trust ... the sponsoring organization is the legal donor of record" and that "Our written acknowledgment ... goes to Kestrel". It adds that any tax benefit was realized when they contributed to the fund.
The memo books "Hard credit: Kestrel Charitable Trust (organization record 30882)", "Soft credit: Margaret and Erik Halvorsen" and "Designation: Studio Wing Campaign" for the full $15,000.
The memo says "Applied to statement of intent Yes — reduce open balance by full $15,000" against the $40,000 statement of intent.

It states "Applying this new $15,000 grant leaves a $5,000 open balance on the statement of intent ($40,000 minus $10,000 minus $10,000 minus $15,000)." It also notes the 2025 gala payment was "No — event, not applied."

The memo notes the 2024-11-12 commitment is on form SW-SOI (rev. 2023-02) and that such commitments "are non-binding statements of intent". It says a DAF grant "may be soft-credited toward it" and quotes the form's "not a legally binding pledge or obligation" language.
